parameters.name: InfectionRateFromSmearPositive
parameters.description: Representative transmission intensity from smear-positive pulmonary TB; the paper fits transmission to incidence and assumes smear-positive disease is the main infectious class

parameters.name: InfectionRateFromSmearNegative
parameters.description: Transmission intensity from smear-negative pulmonary TB, reflecting relative infectiousness of 0.22 compared with smear-positive cases in the paper

parameters.name: RecentToRemoteStabilizationRate
parameters.description: Rate of stabilization from recent TB infection to remote TB infection, corresponding to about 2 years

parameters.name: RapidProgressionToSmearPositiveRate
parameters.description: Rapid progression from recent infection to active smear-positive TB

parameters.name: RapidProgressionToSmearNegativeRate
parameters.description: Rapid progression from recent infection to active smear-negative TB

parameters.name: RapidProgressionToExtrapulmonaryRate
parameters.description: Rapid progression from recent infection to active extrapulmonary TB

parameters.name: ReinfectionRateFromSmearPositive
parameters.description: Re-infection of remote latent TB by smear-positive pulmonary disease, returning to recent infection

parameters.name: ReinfectionRateFromSmearNegative
parameters.description: Re-infection of remote latent TB by smear-negative pulmonary disease, returning to recent infection

parameters.name: RemoteReactivationToSmearPositiveRate
parameters.description: Slow progression / reactivation from remote TB infection to smear-positive disease

parameters.name: RemoteReactivationToSmearNegativeRate
parameters.description: Slow progression / reactivation from remote TB infection to smear-negative disease

parameters.name: RemoteReactivationToExtrapulmonaryRate
parameters.description: Slow progression / reactivation from remote TB infection to extrapulmonary disease

parameters.name: TreatmentOrSelfCureRateSmearPositive
parameters.description: Net rate of leaving active smear-positive TB through diagnosis and treatment or self-cure in the paper's compartmental abstraction

parameters.name: TreatmentOrSelfCureRateSmearNegative
parameters.description: Net rate of leaving active smear-negative TB through diagnosis and treatment or self-cure

parameters.name: TreatmentOrSelfCureRateExtrapulmonary
parameters.description: Net rate of leaving active extrapulmonary TB through diagnosis and treatment

parameters.description: Stabilization of recently treated/recovered individuals into remote TB infection after about 5 years
